whole_spec.description: Explicitly declared age range or visible age presentation of an identified carrier or its explicitly owned local region; local appearance does not establish whole-owner chronological age, and intrinsic adult restrictions remain unchanged.
whole_spec.description_ko: 대상 또는 실제로 소유된 국소 영역의 명시된 연령 범위·보이는 연령 표현. 국소적인 나이 들어 보임·젊어 보임을 주체 전체의 실제 연령으로 확대하지 않으며, 기존 성인 제한은 그대로 누적한다.
excludes: Generic matte/glossy/rough texture, synthetic-skin material, wrinkles or a skin-region name alone without explicitly declared age presentation.
Chronological age, birth/manufacture history, adulthood, species, identity, health or family inferred from local skin or a provenance label.
Aged finish on non-skin material, weathering or damage alone is not subject/region visible age presentation merely because the adjective old/aged appears.

Part ownership is not equivalence: local region age appearance cannot be moved to the whole owner or another region. Distinct actual regions can legitimately have contrasting values on the same whole owner.

Selected age appearance remains E; explicit existing declared-age prerequisites retain P and cannot be used as permission to mutate locked age. Adult/human/domain source guards are neither inferred nor removed.
includes: Keep explicitly declared whole-carrier age range and visible age presentation, without inferring real chronological age from appearance.

An explicitly aged-looking versus young-looking owned skin-region contrast is local visible age presentation. Retain each actual region and owner; no new person, baby, exact age, family relation or global aged/young assignment follows.
A represented or synthetic carrier only receives the visible age presentation actually stated for its own region; representation identity alone is not a living age fact.

When one selection explicitly expresses both local skin microtexture and age appearance, appearance and age are two permission projections of that same semantic selection. Author both footprints consistently under the current proof contract; this is not an instruction for engine inference, automatic duplication or removal of locks.

whole_spec.description: Individually distinguishable airborne particles or droplets and their spatial distribution, separate from an unresolved haze or fog optical field.
whole_spec.description_ko: 공기 중에서 개별 형상·점·궤적으로 구별되는 입자·물방울과 그 분포. 물리적으로 미립자를 포함하더라도 개별 입자 없이 연속 감쇠장으로만 표현된 안개·연무는 atmospheric_medium이며, 수중 입자·영상 입자·표면 방울과 구별한다.
excludes: An unresolved haze or fog field described only through spatial attenuation or contrast loss.
Underwater particles or bubbles, image-plane grain and droplets attached to a surface.
A living airborne animal needs its own declared subject/participant evidence; the particle slot does not add one.
includes: Individually distinguishable airborne particles or droplets and their spatial distribution, separate from an unresolved haze or fog optical field.

whole_spec.description: Ownership and continuity, articulation, attachment or explicitly intended separation of anatomical parts of a declared biological subject, including a plant or declared botanical part. Explicitly depicted anatomy remains owned by its representation; non-anatomical artifact joins remain separate.
whole_spec.description_ko: 선언된 생물 주체의 해부학적 부위 소유·연속·관절·부착 또는 명시적으로 의도된 분리이며, 식물 또는 명시된 식물 부위의 꽃·잎·자기 줄기 연결도 포함한다. 명시된 해부학적 묘사는 그 표현물의 소유 범위에 머문다. 형태·비율·단순 접촉·비해부학적 공예물 접합과 구별하며 생존·성장·종을 추정하지 않는다.
evidence_terms: bloom attached to its own stem
excludes: Anatomical contour, regional volume, relative proportion or part names alone without an actual ownership, continuity, articulation, attachment or intended-separation proposition.
Touching, nearness, overlap or visual alignment of separately owned subjects/objects alone; contact does not merge anatomy or establish a shared biological owner.

Object hinges, hardware branches, textile/lace/paper flower assemblies and floral graphic-path joins alone. Depicted anatomical connection requires an explicitly declared anatomical depiction and remains scoped there, never inferred live continuity.

Continuity/attachment does not prove that an owner is alive, growing, functional, healthy, a particular species or made by a particular process; a cut or depicted botanical part does not gain a hidden whole plant.

An artifact or picture cannot alter/add a living actor or plant merely because its design resembles a biological part. Actor/plant/representation owner labels, source effects and optional members/profiles are not independent anatomical evidence.
includes: Ownership and continuity, articulation or explicitly intended separation of declared human or other animal anatomical parts, retaining each actual owner and endpoint.

The declared botanical bloom remaining attached to its own woody stem; separate blossoms attaching along the same continuous branch; leaves belonging to that same declared plant/branch. Source-stated absence or separation is retained without inventing extra organs.

Explicit anatomical attachment/continuity within a declared representation remains on the represented anatomy. A flat ornament path or assembled craft junction alone does not establish an anatomical relation.

Where a fabric rosette and a separate existing biological flower coexist, their distinct owners remain distinct: the flower own petal/stem relation cannot be donated to the garment, and cloth attachment cannot be recast as plant growth.

whole_spec.description: Owned non-facial anatomical contour, regional volume or visible muscle and tendon form of a declared biological subject, including a plant or declared botanical part. Explicitly depicted anatomy remains owned by its representation. Independent of connection topology, relative proportions, pose, garment fit and non-anatomical artifact construction.
whole_spec.description_ko: 선언된 생물 주체의 얼굴 이외 해부학적 윤곽·국소 부피·근육·힘줄 형태이며, 식물 또는 명시된 식물 부위의 기관 형태도 포함한다. 명시된 해부학적 묘사는 그 표현물의 소유 범위에 머문다. 연결 구조·상대 비율·자세·의복 부피·비해부학적 물건 구조와 구별하며 생존 상태·종·건강·능력·정체성을 추정하지 않는다.
excludes: Body/plant region names, biological class words or connection topology alone without an independently stated anatomical contour or regional form.
Relative proportions, pose, facial geometry, garment fit or non-anatomical object/garment construction alone.

Floral graphic paths, repeating vegetal ornament, branch-shaped hardware or fabric/paper/lace flower parts do not become biological anatomy from resemblance or petal/stem labels. An explicitly declared anatomical depiction may describe represented organs only; its physical carrier remains an artifact.
A represented or artificial anatomical form does not alter or add a living actor/plant, and does not establish that its carrier is alive or that any depicted species exists physically.
Body weight, health, strength, biological age, origin, species, growth capacity, material chemistry or fabrication inferred from form.
Source owner, positive form and actual application scope must be explicit; metadata, source effects, an optional member/profile or an actor/plant/representation role word alone is not a form fact.
includes: Restrained visible muscle planes on a declared human or other animal; a localized neck vein contour or gluteal-thigh surface fold.

Large distinct floral segments forming an open cup on the declared botanical bloom; broad bounded leaf form or layered flower-organ form on its own declared plant owner. Plant form is not a claim of physiological life, growth capacity or species identification.

Explicitly depicted biological anatomy, including represented botanical organ form, stays on its declared representation. The source must actually describe anatomical form, not merely a floral style, motif or generic craft part.

A biological flower and a fabric rosette may occur in the same record, but anatomical form is assessed only on the declared biological flower or explicit anatomical depiction; cloth-fold form remains on the garment/craft owner.

whole_spec.description: Explicit whole-body posture or support, or explicitly stated local non-hand articulation of an identified biological, mechanical or represented body. Preserve the declared local part and its existing body ownership without inferring unmentioned anatomy.
whole_spec.description_ko: 생물·기계·묘사된 몸의 명시적 전신 자세·지지, 또는 직접 선언된 손 이외 국소 부위의 관절 자세. 실제 국소 부위와 기존 몸의 소유 관계를 보존하며 언급하지 않은 해부 부위나 지지 접촉을 추론하지 않는다.
excludes: A rigid object shape, a camera viewpoint or an activity word alone does not establish a whole-body pose.
Relative rotation of body axes, hand articulation, concrete action and rendered motion have separate roles when supported.
Do not turn an unavailable body or limb into a new entity to satisfy a pose.

Hand/finger articulation keeps hand_pose; explicit axis orientation or relative regional rotation keeps body_orientation. A local pose does not receive duplicate roles solely by renaming the same flexion as a rotation. A joint/hinge label, static object construction or generic believable movement alone does not supply a selected local articulated posture.
includes: Explicit standing, sitting, lying or other whole-body posture of a declared human, animal, robot or represented body.
Preserve the actual support and articulated connections when declared. Standing alone does not supply feet, legs, a supporting ground contact or a human body.
Decide effect versus a required existing posture from the whole source; source-specific category and domain conditions remain cumulative.

An explicitly bent elbow is a local articulated posture of that same owned elbow; it does not supply a full-body stance, an exact flexion angle, upper-arm/forearm inventory, a second actor or actual bending motion.

whole_spec.description: Named anatomical region or selected body part, distinct from the obligation to prove its visibility.
whole_spec.description_ko: 선택된 신체 부위와 관찰 범위: 부위 자체와 이를 보여야 하는 검증 의무를 분리; framing·해부 연결과 연계
excludes: 부위 자체와 이를 보여야 하는 검증 의무를 분리; framing·해부 연결과 연계
includes: Named anatomical region or selected body part, distinct from the obligation to prove its visibility.

whole_spec.description: Arrangement of declared elements and negative space within one frame.
whole_spec.description_ko: 프레임 안의 요소 배치와 공간 관계: 촬영 범위·플랫폼 안전 영역을 구별; 각 역할을 실제로 표현할 때만 다중 연결
excludes: 촬영 범위·플랫폼 안전 영역을 구별; 각 역할을 실제로 표현할 때만 다중 연결
includes: Arrangement of declared elements and negative space within one frame.

whole_spec.description: Explicit contact, support or occlusion relation with each endpoint and owner identified.
whole_spec.description_ko: 연결된 소유자·신체 부위·물건의 접촉 관계: 행동명과 구별; 지지·가림·압력 표현은 실제 연결과 상태 근거 필요
excludes: 행동명과 구별; 지지·가림·압력 표현은 실제 연결과 상태 근거 필요
includes: Explicit contact, support or occlusion relation with each endpoint and owner identified.

whole_spec.description: Observable facial or eye-area response belonging to one declared human or animal, or visibly presented by an explicitly declared artificial face or face representation. Includes expression-related brow position relative to facial landmarks; not a proven private emotion, consciousness or hidden muscle action. Artificial and represented responses remain on their declared carriers.
whole_spec.description_ko: 선언된 사람·동물의 관찰 가능한 얼굴·눈 주위 반응, 또는 명시된 인공 얼굴·얼굴 표현물에 실제로 드러난 표정 반응. 얼굴 기준점에 대한 표정성 눈썹 위치를 포함한다. 인공·묘사된 반응은 선언된 물체·표현물의 소유 범위에 머물며, 사적인 감정·의식·숨은 근육 작동이나 시선 방향·목표·눈맞춤을 추정하지 않는다.
excludes: 시선 목표와 사적인 마음 상태를 표정 사실로 취급하지 않음
Eye or iris direction, a named gaze target or camera/participant engagement alone; these properties require their own evidence and roles.
Consciousness, absence of mind, actual emotion, personality, intention, successful perception or hidden muscle operation inferred from an expression, including empty-looking machine gaze.
Face shape or proportions, sensor/optical-iris hardware, material, skin finish, grooming or cosmetic line alone without a positively declared facial response.

An artificial or represented facial response does not imply living skin, biological eyes or eyelids, newly added facial parts, a living carrier or an additional human/animal. Preserve the actual artificial or representation owner; do not convert it to biological anatomy.

Metadata, old slot names/effects, an optional member/profile, or an actor/object/representation owner label alone cannot supply a face, facial response or unconditional application scope. Intrinsic source conditions and independently frozen binding conditions remain conjunctive and unchanged.
includes: Observable facial or eye-area response of one declared human or animal, including expression-related brow position relative to facial landmarks, without proving private emotion.

An explicitly declared artificial face presenting an empty-looking machine gaze or a too-precisely held social expression. The source must positively describe the visible facial response; robot identity or sensor hardware alone is insufficient.

A visible expression explicitly described on one declared face representation remains owned by that representation and its carrier. It neither creates a living actor nor transfers a depicted response to another subject. A generic facial resemblance or ornament label alone is insufficient.

whole_spec.description: Declared footwear type, construction and appearance on an explicitly owned shoe object, or an explicitly selected local foot region visibly uncovered by footwear and socks. Bind an absence state to the wearer and named foot region, never to a nonexistent shoe; wearing and standalone-object use remain distinct.
whole_spec.description_ko: 소유된 신발의 종류·구조·외관, 또는 명시된 착용자의 지정 발 부위가 신발·양말 없이 드러난 상태. 부재 상태는 존재하지 않는 신발이 아니라 같은 착용자의 해당 발 부위에 결속한다. 국소 노출에서 두 발·전신 맨발을 추정하지 않는다.
excludes: 신발 착용과 단독 물체 제시를 명시적으로 구별하며, 바닥 소품의 배치는 prop_placement로 별도 판단한다. 작은 신발 부류도 독립 속성을 표현하면 유효하다.
Missing, cropped or occluded footwear is not affirmative absence evidence; skin-colored or open-toe shoes cannot substitute for the selected uncovered-foot state.
Footwear contact/crop legibility alone selects neither shoe type nor an uncovered state.
No shoe entity is introduced or deleted by semantic qualification; local evidence does not establish both feet or whole-body absence.
includes: Declared footwear type, construction and appearance on an explicitly owned shoe object, or an explicitly selected local foot region visibly uncovered by footwear and socks. Bind an absence state to the wearer and named foot region, never to a nonexistent shoe; wearing and standalone-object use remain distinct.

whole_spec.description: Construction, topology, trim or local form of an identified garment, whether worn, displayed, standalone or represented, distinct from anatomy and material identity.
whole_spec.description_ko: 착용·전시·단독·묘사된 의복 자체의 구조·연결·트림·국소 형태. 실제 의복 소유자를 확인하며 인체 구조·피부 표식·재질 정체와 구별한다.
excludes: Cloth material or an unowned edge alone is not a garment construction detail.
A garment detail does not establish a wearer, anatomy, exposure, fit, material identity or clothing ensemble.
Do not remove any intrinsic source-specific human, adult or domain restriction.
includes: An actual garment-owned seam, cuff, hem, sleeve, trim or construction relation; an independently declared human wearer is not compulsory.
If a wearer, layering relation, support or attachment is required by the source, preserve that specific condition rather than deriving it from the slot.
Separately supported material, texture, fit, layering or state can have their own roles without duplicating the garment.

whole_spec.description: Relation of a garment's volume and contour to its declared wearer, without inferring body shape from clothing.
whole_spec.description_ko: 의복 핏: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Relation of a garment's volume and contour to its declared wearer, without inferring body shape from clothing.

whole_spec.description: Current garment wear, fastening, wetness or deformation, separate from construction and body state.
whole_spec.description_ko: 의복의 현재 상태: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Current garment wear, fastening, wetness or deformation, separate from construction and body state.

whole_spec.description: Static shape and articulation of owned hands and fingers, with support and contact represented separately.
whole_spec.description_ko: 소유 손의 정적 형태와 연결: 물건 사용 동작·손 접촉과 구별; 실제로 둘을 표현하면 다중 역할 허용
excludes: 물건 사용 동작·손 접촉과 구별; 실제로 둘을 표현하면 다중 역할 허용
includes: Static shape and articulation of owned hands and fingers, with support and contact represented separately.

whole_spec.description: Illumination softness, angular extent and resulting shadow transition, separate from intensity and image exposure.
whole_spec.description_ko: 빛의 경계와 광질: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
A source device name or ambiguous named lighting look alone does not establish softness, angular extent or shadow transition.
includes: Illumination softness, angular extent and resulting shadow transition, separate from intensity and image exposure.

whole_spec.description: Explicit spatial geometry of illumination, highlights or shadow boundaries on an identified receiving surface or within a declared illuminated spatial region.
whole_spec.description_ko: 특정 수광 표면 또는 명시된 공간 영역에 나타나는 빛·하이라이트·그림자 경계의 공간 형태. 표면 무늬와 명시적 입체 광선 분포를 실제 범위에 맞게 구별한다.
excludes: A ray shape does not itself identify a lamp, camera, fog, smoke, dust particles or the physical scattering mechanism.
Spatial shape alone does not supply incident direction, light intensity, color temperature or the type of source.
Sacred/revelatory wording does not create a deity, religious event or an otherwise unmentioned world fact.
includes: A source-declared light pattern or shadow boundary on its actual receiving surface.
Explicit volumetric rays or other spatial light geometry can use their declared spatial region; a physical receiving surface is not compulsory for that meaning.
Preserve the source geometry, carrier and actual light/receiver relation. The source may require additional independently grounded owners.

whole_spec.description: Light-source type and emission mechanism, distinct from exposure trails and image artifacts.
whole_spec.description_ko: 광원의 종류와 발생 방식: 긴 노출 궤적은 motion_rendering 계열; 광원 정체와 영상 흔적 구별
excludes: 긴 노출 궤적은 motion_rendering 계열; 광원 정체와 영상 흔적 구별
A named day phase or lighting look alone does not identify a source type or emission mechanism.
includes: Light-source type and emission mechanism, distinct from exposure trails and image artifacts.

whole_spec.description: Explicit macroscopic contour, bounded volume shape or coherent spatial form of an identified non-anatomical fluid, deformable material mass or transient material body, independent of constructed-object structure and illumination geometry.
whole_spec.description_ko: 명시된 비해부학적 유체·변형 가능한 물질 덩어리·일시적 물질체 자체의 거시적 윤곽·부피 형상·응집된 공간 형태. 공예·물건의 구조와 빛의 투사·광선 형상에서 분리한다.
excludes: Geometry or part assembly of a separately identified discrete object, vessel, fixture or constructed item belongs to object_structure; garment construction and anatomy retain their specialized roles. A material-body contour is not a container or emitter-housing contour. Softness alone does not turn a constructed object or textile panel into a free material mass. Preserve the actual declared carrier and do not duplicate the same contour by renaming it object or matter.

Receiving-surface illumination, volumetric rays, highlights and shadow boundaries are light_shape, not the contour of a luminous material body. A teardrop-shaped flame does not establish a teardrop projection on a surface.
Material identity, chemistry, temperature, phase transition, emission mechanism, motion, texture, optical sheen or moisture alone without a positive macroscopic shape proposition.
Airborne particle units/distribution, unresolved haze/attenuation and liquid inclusions alone are owned by their respective roles; an additional explicit material-body contour requires its own fact.
A drawn/printed flame or teardrop motif, a rigid teardrop lamp housing or an image artifact is not an actual flame/fluid body from resemblance.
Do not infer combustion mechanism, fuel, heat, a droplet, exact dimensions, permanence, a newly introduced body or an actual ritual from a shape adjective.
includes: A positively described teardrop contour of the flame body itself; its luminous source type and key-light use are separate facts.

An explicitly shaped fluid ribbon, coherent liquid blob or deformable material mass, with its actual body/region and physical extent identified. These are normative boundary examples, not newly corpus-reviewed candidates.
A selected form is an appearance effect; a separately required existing form or expressly preserved form retains its actual mode. No new material body follows from the slot name.

whole_spec.description: Visible non-anatomical geometry, bounded parts and structural connections owned by one declared physical object or fixture, independent of its scene role, frame placement and current use state.
whole_spec.description_ko: 선언된 물리적 물체·설비 자체의 비해부학적 형상, 경계가 있는 부품과 구조적 연결. 장면에서 맡는 용도·프레임 배치·현재 사용 상태와 구별하며, 몸·의복 특화 구조의 소유 범위를 보존한다.
excludes: Anatomical form, pose or continuity, including depicted anatomy whose representation ownership must remain explicit.
Frame arrangement, camera viewpoint, relative prop placement or image acuity alone.
Current open/closed, use, damage or readiness state without a separately evidenced structural feature.
Material identity or repeated surface microstructure alone; abstract two-dimensional graphic-path geometry alone.

A garment-specific construction fact already fully owned by garment_detail does not receive a duplicate generic role for that same fact. Simultaneous roles require separately evidenced properties or distinct owned components.
An optional garment member/profile cannot supply unconditional garment ownership or garment type to a generic parent.

Macroscopic form of a free fluid, coherent material mass or transient material body is material_form when that material body is the actual declared carrier. A separately identified vessel, fixture, discrete object or constructed item keeps its own object_structure scope. Do not duplicate the same contour merely by renaming its carrier object or matter.
includes: A declared case hinge and separately bounded disc recess; phone halves joined at their hinge.
A named strap assembly with a bar and incoming/returning strap path; a generic attached textile panel with its own bounded edge.
An identified fixture part and its structural joint; no claim of hidden manufacture or performance.

whole_spec.description: Physical motion or rest of declared actors, objects and materials, separate from recorded streaks or shake.

whole_spec.description: Concrete interaction with explicitly declared action endpoints, including biological, mechanical or represented participants and their objects.
whole_spec.description_ko: 명시된 행위 주체와 상대·물체 사이의 구체적 상호 동작. 인간·동물·기계·묘사된 대상을 포함하며 실제 행위와 소유·접촉 관계를 구별한다.
excludes: A role label, co-presence, proximity or an isolated hand pose does not supply a performed interaction.
Do not add a counterpart, helper, contact, tool or action endpoint from a verb category alone.
Do not split one actual self-owned body into two people or merge explicitly distinct participants.
includes: The source explicitly describes the participants or a participant and an object interacting; each endpoint must be independently supported.
Self-directed interaction can address an explicitly owned part or object while retaining its actual part/whole relationship.
A human participant is not compulsory. Intrinsic source conditions, distinctness or part ownership, and actual performed action remain mandatory.

includes: Declared surface material and observable optical response; chemical identity and performance require separate context.

whole_spec.description: Bounded visible motif geometry and its layout, adjacency or explicitly stated repetition on one declared non-anatomical surface or design field, independent of physical surface microstructure, material identity, local hue and whole-frame composition.
whole_spec.description_ko: 선언된 비해부학적 표면·도안 영역 하나에 속한, 경계가 있는 시각 모티프의 형상·배치·인접 관계와 명시된 경우에만 반복. 물리적 미세조직·재질·국소 색상·사진 전체 구도와 구별하며, 반복 없는 한정된 모티프에도 해당한다.
excludes: Physical weave, knit loops, raised ribs, roughness or relief alone without a separately declared visual motif/layout; these belong to texture, with material identity and optical response assessed separately.
Uniform local hue, palette, brightness or bounded color placement alone without a motif; color remains separate and no fixed palette follows from a motif name.
Whole photographic frame arrangement, negative space, crop or subject placement; a depicted design field remains on its own owner rather than becoming the surrounding photograph layout.

Owned anatomy or markings on a body/skin/hair surface, including a depicted body when the clause actually describes its anatomy or marking; use the appropriate anatomical, body_marking or makeup/hair role. An animal-shaped artifact ornament is not a new animal.
Garment-specific seam, opening, fold, trim attachment or construction alone; an actual visual print is not automatically garment_detail, and a generic fabric owner is not automatically a garment.
Physical object part assembly, hinge, cavity or strap routing alone without a separately stated motif/design relation; object_structure remains distinct.
Image grain/compression/lens artifacts, illumination/shadow projections or optical interference alone; a receiving-surface pattern is not inferred solely from lighting or processing.
Literal readable text content, symbolic belief, cultural affiliation, biological species, provenance, fabrication process, hidden chemistry or historical identity inferred from a motif.
An unbounded style label, metadata keyword, old effect/property name, optional child or render guard cannot supply positive motif geometry, owner identity, repetition or additional actors.
includes: A figural or vegetal ornamental motif whose line/shape joins belong to the same declared artifact surface or design field; no repetition is required unless separately stated.
Hooked teardrop motifs explicitly repeating on one declared garment print; orthogonal equal-width bands forming small checks on one declared fabric surface.
Geometric interlace cells with explicitly consistent adjacency on one artifact-bound design; graphic motif contours explicitly continuing across neighboring repeated design-tile boundaries.

A separately evidenced visual motif may coexist with physical relief, weave or local color on the same owner, but each role requires its own positive property. A flat print can establish motif geometry without establishing physical relief or a printing process.

whole_spec.description: Physical surface organization, roughness and repeated structure, not image-plane grain, compression or air particles.
